newsitem.title: CHINA: China February RPI up 2.9 pct yr/yr - Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: China February RPI up 2.9 pct yr/yr - Xinhua.

text.p: China's retail price inflation rose 2.9 percent year-on-year in February, the official Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday, quoting the State Planning Commission.
Retail price inflation in February was up by 1.7 percent compared with January, the bureau said.
Price rises for foodstuffs in some regions around China's lunar new year holiday in February had helped fuel inflation druing the month, the bureau said.
Prices for chemical fertiliser and pesticides were stable now and would help spring planting, it said.
China's retail price inflation, the figure China uses as its benchmark for nationwide inflation, was 3.3 percent in January.
Retail price inflation was 6.1 percent in 1996, down from 14.8 percent in 1995 and from a communist-era high of 21.7 percent in 1994.
